# Brief

Hand-written, no brief: the v0.5 send-outs fixture, `vet-core`'s record and
`vet-lab`'s laboratory loaded through `gmctl load-data` with the purposes'
DDL, the lab's results delivered to the region's practices
(`vet-lab-practice-results`) and its send-outs posted to the external
reference lab (`vet-lab-send-outs`) by the integration engine, the two
partners' stubs on the partners' three nodes, deployed by
`run-short-test.sh` (chunk 18b). Not a game.
